![Region R partitioned into S, T, and U.](images/ed/ed0be2aca8d43d733e91f3a8feaaca0649957dcbd516a8218b1e7dea136170d8.png)

The finite region $R$ consists of $S$, $T$, and $U$, whose interiors do not overlap. An integrable function $f$ satisfies

$$
\begin{aligned}
\iint_{T\cup S} f(x,y)\,\mathrm{d}A&=3,\\\iint_{S} f(x,y)\,\mathrm{d}A&=7,\\\iint_{R} f(x,y)\,\mathrm{d}A&=0.
\end{aligned}
$$

Define

$$
g(x,y)=\begin{cases}0,&(x,y)\in S\\(-3)f(x,y),&(x,y)\in T\\(2)f(x,y),&(x,y)\in U.\end{cases}
$$

Values on shared boundaries do not affect the integrals. Find

$$
\iint_{R} g(x,y)\,\mathrm{d}A.
$$

Define

$$
g(x,y)=\begin{cases}(2)f(x,y),&(x,y)\in S\\(3)f(x,y),&(x,y)\in T\\0,&(x,y)\in U.\end{cases}

Values on shared boundaries do not affect the integrals. Find

$$
\iint_{R} g(x,y)\,\mathrm{d}A.
$$
